claims.says: Inserting an entry below 2^128 into a well-formed copy-on-write B+ tree keeps it well-formed and makes its entries exactly the sorted-set insertion of that entry into the old ones.
On every configuration the const assert admits, removing an entry below 2^128 from a well-formed tree keeps it well-formed and leaves the old entry list with that entry erased.
A range scan from lo to hi on a well-formed tree, with a limit at least the entry count, returns exactly the entries whose key lies in that inclusive range, in order.
On every configuration the const assert admits, batch removal of a sorted batch from a well-formed tree succeeds, keeps it well-formed, and leaves exactly the entries not in the batch.
Under the const assert, every tree built from empty or from_sorted by any sequence of insert, remove, insert_batch and remove_batch calls is well-formed.
